name: obsidian_append
description: Appends or writes text to an existing Obsidian note. Use for: 'add this to my Aegon journal', 'append this idea to project notes', 'add a line to my note called X', 'write in the note X', 'write to note X', 'put this in my note X'. Never overwrites existing content.

title.description: The title of the note to append to.

content.description: The text to append to the note.
